name: Ernst Fuchs Museum
notes: No usable event data: homepage has no ld+json/calendar, wp-json posts endpoint has only 2 ever-published posts ('Aktuelles') and both are bare image+title with no exhibition date range in the body, only a post-published date. The regiondo.at ticket widget (linked from the site) lists a single undated general-admission ticket, no dated events. Museum is effectively a permanent private collection with occasional undated special-exhibition announcements; nothing here maps to a dated occurrence without fabricating dates.
